description: This file defines a database migration class for version 4.0 of the OrangeHRM system. It creates a new database table 'ohrm_employee_event', adds menu items related to OAuth client registration, and retrieves existing menu IDs.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: Migration class for database schema updates for OrangeHRM version 4.0, handling creation of tables and menu entries.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs the migration, creating the 'ohrm_employee_event' table and inserting menu items for OAuth client registration.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string '4.0' indicating the migration version.
